v1.0.0n (2 January 2022) |previous_update = [[Overhaul v1.4]] |next_update = [[v1.0.1]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.0.0''' was the thirtieth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 4th of December 2021. This update is notable for bringing the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], the ninth event in Tower Defense Simulator. This update was nominated in Roblox Innovation Awards for "Best Content Update", but lost. If Tower Defense Simulator had won, [[The Umbra]] would have returned, and players would receive a gift from the developers. This is the first update to use the in-game version numbering scheme, however, it only received it when it was added in the next update, [[v1.0.1]]. This update also has another name, '''Solar Eclipse Update''', as it brought the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. This version encompassed fifteen updates, the main v1.0.0 update (released 4 December 2021) and fourteen minor updates, the v1.0.0a (added Night I, released 4 December 2021), v1.0.0b (added Night II, released 6 December 2021), v1.0.0c (released 8 December 2021), v1.0.0d (added Night III, released 8 December 2021), v1.0.0e (released 8 December 2021), v1.0.0f (released 11 December 2021), v1.0.0g
